authorship: Codex visual inspection of r0 screenshot; no model generated these critiques
observation: Sophisticated editorial split layout, but it reads as a cleaning-service advertisement more than the requested floor scene. Mop and spill are undersized in a huge blank beige field; liquid lacks believable wetness/texture.

independent_axis_critiques.layout: Make the floor scene dominant and crop it more deliberately; reduce promotional sidebar width.
independent_axis_critiques.spacing: Use asymmetry intentionally but remove the dead beige void around the tiny objects.
independent_axis_critiques.color_type: Retain warm editorial palette; add floor-grain contrast and translucent reflected highlights.
independent_axis_critiques.style_orig: Render a convincing wet spill, mop fibers and contact shadow; remove unsupported marketing metrics/CTA emphasis.

cross_critique_tradeoff: A larger realistic scene could lose the elegant editorial restraint. Use one close, art-directed crop rather than adding objects or photorealistic noise.
fused_revision: Recenter the page on the requested cleaning scene rather than a service ad. Make the floor image area larger and use an art-directed close crop where the mop head approaches a translucent wet spill. Add subtle wood/tile grain, irregular liquid edge, specular reflection and contact shadows. Keep the warm minimalist editorial typography, but reduce or remove promotional metrics and make the visual scene the clear subject.
axes_moderated_revision: Narrow and simplify the left editorial column, then enlarge/recompose the right floor scene so mop and spill form a clear diagonal focal relationship. Remove dead beige space. Improve the floor with restrained grain and the spill with translucency, irregular edges, reflected highlights and believable shadows. Keep the black/cream/yellow palette and crisp typography but de-emphasize ad-like stats and CTA.
mad_moderated_revision: Preserve the elegant editorial split, but shift its ratio toward the scene and use a close diagonal composition of mop head, wet fibers and spill. Make wetness legible through an irregular translucent edge, two reflected highlights and soft contact shadow; add only subtle floor grain. Simplify promotional copy/metrics so the screen reads first as the requested cleaning scene, not a landing-page advertisement.
